prompt: A painterly anime fantasy background painting, a cinematic matte painting with visible brushwork, late afternoon turning to golden hour, a soft blue sky warming to orange at the horizon, warm low sunlight from the left. The view is from the grey steel foredeck of an ancient airship flying high in the sky: riveted steel deck plates with seams running to the pointed bow, a pale stencilled plate across the keel, a round gold dial set into the plating on the right, thin dark metal railings along both edges, and beyond the bow only a long drop. Ahead and below, a sea of soft clouds. Right beside the ship, so close it fills the right half of the sky, the flank of the monster rises from below the ship on the right like a curving wall of scales, and out of it rises one colossal clawed arm of a living sea monster, as big as a mountain: a thick scaly forearm of overlapping dark slate-grey scales and ridges of cracked stone, rough and craggy like an ancient weathered cliff, a broad ribbed fin of dark grey membrane along its back edge, ending at the top in a huge open hand with four long hooked black talons spread wide like a grasping claw. It is a limb, not a head: it has no eye, no mouth and no teeth anywhere on it. Where the arm joins the monster's vast scaled flank, a round glowing core the size of a house is set deep into the flesh like a great pearl, shining a soft pale violet light. Its shadow falls across the deck. It is entirely a living animal made of rock and scale: no metal, no gold, no machine parts, no pipes, no bolts, no poles, no buildings on it. No people.
